design.basis: Illustrative reference hypotheses for mathematical screening; no member selection, measured hardware, load rating or approval

base_interfaces.interpretation: Declared ideal lift/slew/short-slide interfaces and point masses; actual hardware, anchorage, transport and foundation behavior are unmodeled

mass_ledger.scope: All declared bars, floor, rails and node fittings plus two stationary base mass ledgers; omitted hardware is not implicitly massless in reality

mode_definitions.independent_half_cantilevers: No seam ties; all four root-node translations held on each half
mode_definitions.joined_clamped: All four seam-node pairs tied; all root translations still held
mode_definitions.joined_service: All four seam-node pairs tied; four z bearings, two y guides on one global edge, one x restraint
mode_definitions.lower_only_join_after_release: Only the two lower seam pairs tied; permanent service bearings only
mode_definitions.premature_release_before_join: No seam ties; permanent service bearings only
mode_definitions.joined_release_midpoint: All four ties; permanent bearings zero and temporary root translations prescribed at half their service-dead values

checks_not_performed: Reference geometry, areas, material, masses and crowd pressures are declared hypotheses, not observations or selected capacities
Linear pin-jointed axial bars only: no member bending, torsion, buckling, geometric nonlinearity, yielding or fatigue checks
No deck plate, guards, connections, center locks, mast, bearings, actuators, chassis, pads, soil or anchorage capacity model
No dynamic, vibration, impact, wind-on-truss or moving-load response model
The rigid/deformable mode change uses ideal ties and prescribed translations, not a validated physical control sequence
No accessibility, pedestrian layout, transport envelope, fabrication or operational approval

scalar_extrema.interpretation: Response extrema only; no allowable-stress, deformation or capacity criterion applied

release_certificate.scope: Algebraic equilibrium path for commanded ideal restraints, not instant release or validated actuator/control hardware

capture_reference.scope: Small-displacement dead-load cantilever shapes under ideal root clamps; capture tolerance, contact and actuation are separate

checks_not_performed: Reference geometry, areas, material, masses and crowd pressures are declared hypotheses, not observations or selected capacities
Linear pin-jointed axial bars only: no member bending, torsion, buckling, geometric nonlinearity, yielding or fatigue checks

No accessibility, pedestrian layout, transport envelope, fabrication or operational approval

motion.architecture: Prescribed ideal lift, yaw and short-slide fixtures carrying two unchanged rigid deck-truss halves
motion.coordinate_convention: x=0..span across road; y along road; z up; base centre y=-pivot_y; exact proper rotations

separation_certificates.scope: Centreline prisms touch at final seam; inflated member envelopes are separated outside the declared joint zone. Actual engagement/contact inside that zone and omitted hardware remain unresolved
Centreline prisms touch at final seam; inflated member envelopes are separated outside the declared joint zone. Actual engagement/contact inside that zone and omitted hardware remain unresolved

loaded_capture.meaning: Independent-half elastic dead-load endpoint from the bound structural case; no foundation error, joint compliance or physical engagement

assembled_support.scope: Complete FE reaction force and moment at each root, translated to the pad plane, plus fixed base weights and declared external fixture loads. This proves existence of coplanar nonnegative vertical pad forces only; no ground, sliding, torsional restraint or hardware capacity.

reference_clearance.source: ../v2/oregon-design-basis.md; captured ODOT HDM 0300 reference, applicability unresolved
reference_clearance.scope: Lowest endpoint of every linear axial member, minus declared radius, in the small-displacement model over one flat reference road plane. No real road crown, differential settlement, dynamic deflection, vehicle envelope or as-built survey is certified.

scope: The same physical member and true-mass ledger is used for every pose
Support proof covers all path parameters and the four corners of the declared fixture-force box
Fixed-height horizontal fixture loads act on the base interface; they are not a bridge wind model or wind-speed limit
Coplanar compressive pad reaction existence only; no individual pad load, sliding, ground or anchorage capacity
The prescribed fixture is not a derived actuator mechanism, transport qualification or dynamic model
Sweep boxes enclose nodes, floor corners and mass points with a declared member-radius allowance; complete railing and hardware geometry is absent
Approach endpoint allows ideal common seam contact; connection forces, deformation compatibility and engagement are separate
No public operation follows from any computed pass
